title: Refresh the snapshot monitor transport
prompt: Review this PR for actionable defects. The PR updates the snapshot monitor's HTTP client dependency and simplifies its transport setup. The repository is the post-PR state; pr.diff contains the changes.
notes_private: Clean control. Removes the wrapper transport and uses Got's native transport with pooling opted out; status uses response.statusCode. Verified JSON, request ID, success status and HTTP failure against a local HTTP server. bun.lock pins the post-PR environment and is not part of the review diff.
